capabilities: Open Gnome Terminal from a sidebar action icon
Run a Python module from a main.py file in the vault root
extras: Linux-only; requires gnome-terminal and python3 installed. README is brief and points to a CLI menu example via main.py.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to launch a system terminal or run a local Python script from the vault.
summary: Sidebar action plugin that opens Gnome Terminal and can run a Python module (main.py) placed in the vault root.
